strings.dlg.c3.cond_02.irina: In Karsk our dispatcher would have logged a van like that long ago. No escort?
strings.dlg.c3.cond_02.secrecy: I’m only asking. A van with no escort?
strings.dlg.c3.ctrl_05.irina: I knew nothing about it. Our dispatcher countersigned – for the tracks, not for a van.
strings.dlg.c3.ctrl_05.secrecy: I knew nothing about it. In Karsk nobody countersigned this order.
strings.dlg.c3.el_02.irina: A colleague taught me to look twice. Once for the file, once for the people.
strings.dlg.c3.el_06.secrecy: And you tell this to a stranger in the station café?
strings.dlg.c3.arr_02.evidence: They checked the luggage at the station, Director. My drawing tube too.
strings.dlg.c3.arr_02.suspicion: They opened my luggage twice at the station, Director. Only mine.
strings.dlg.c3.arr_03.suspicion: The plans for Kordon-17 to the minutes office. Your enquiry from Berlin is on my desk, by the way. I shan’t answer it here.
strings.dlg.c3.meet_03.elena: Frau Weiss and I had arranged to meet after the session. Here, at booth two.
strings.dlg.c3.meet_03.evidence: The weighbill names this building as consignee. I have the seal number. For the rest I need Frau Weiss.
strings.dlg.c3.meet_07.irina: Three wagons are missing in Karsk, same series as on the papers here. A colleague counted them – her name is next to mine.
strings.dlg.c3.meet_07.secrecy: Three wagons are missing in Karsk, same series as on the papers here. Nobody there knows I’m asking. It should stay that way.
strings.dlg.c3.meet_08.evidence: In Berlin a corridor bears the same series. I have a copy of the memo. Whether I show it to you, I don’t know yet.
strings.dlg.c3.meet_08.suspicion: In Berlin a corridor bears the same series. I asked about it officially. Since then someone’s been looking over my shoulder.
strings.choice.c3a.note_alone.irina: Note the seal number for Irina’s file and keep searching alone
strings.choice.c3a.note_alone.secrecy: Note the seal number – and once again tell nobody
strings.choice.c3b.share_protocol.evidence: Show him Elena’s note – and the copy of Emil’s memo
strings.choice.c3b.share_protocol.suspicion: Show him Elena’s note, although your office is watching you
strings.choice.c3b.report_delegation.suspicion: Go through official channels – as with the enquiry in Berlin
strings.dlg.c3.react.ask_elena: After the opening session, booth two. Bring your travel order – I’ll bring the three versions.
strings.dlg.c3.react.note_alone: As you wish. But numbers don’t translate themselves.
strings.dlg.c3.react.share_protocol: Escorted goods. My papers say freight. – Tonight at 23:40 a train leaves for Kordon-17, non-stop. Now you know something too.
strings.dlg.c3.react.search_elena: At the station she interpreted for the border officer. I’ll ask there. You ask here. Separately.
strings.dlg.c3.react.report_delegation: Then we never met, Herr Adler.
strings.dlg.c3.react.report_delegation.elena: Report it. But don’t mention Frau Weiss by name.
